Join a team committed to a mission! 
 At Leidos , we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.
 
 Are you ready for your next career challenge? 
 The Defense Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Web and Application Developer to work at Ft. Gordon, GA. In support of the Warfighter Readiness program.
 
 Position Summary
 The Web and Application Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining web-based applications, mobile applications, and supporting software systems. This position works closely with project managers, designers, stakeholders, and end users to create secure, scalable, and user-friendly solutions that meet organizational objectives. The developer will support the full software development lifecycle, including planning, coding, debugging, deployment, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.
 The ideal candidate possesses strong programming knowledge, experience with modern development frameworks, and the ability to work independently or within a collaborative development environment. This role requires analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and the capability to adapt to evolving technologies and project requirements.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain websites, web applications, and mobile applications.

 Write, test, debug, and deploy code for front-end and back-end systems.

 Build and maintain databases, APIs, and system integrations.

 Ensure applications are secure, responsive, and optimized for performance.

 Troubleshoot software issues and provide technical support.

 Collaborate with designers, developers, and stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver solutions.

 Maintain technical documentation and version control repositories.

 Support software updates, enhancements, and cybersecurity compliance.

 
 Web Development 
 Design, develop, and maintain responsive websites and web applications.

 Create front-end user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks.

 Develop server-side functionality and APIs to support web applications.

 Optimize websites and applications for performance, scalability, and usability.

 Ensure compatibility across browsers, operating systems, and mobile devices.

 Integrate databases, cloud services, and third-party APIs.

 Application Development 
 Develop and maintain desktop and mobile applications for iOS, Android, and cross-platform environments.

 Build secure and scalable application architectures.

 Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and technical issues.

 Participate in software testing, quality assurance, and deployment activities.

 Implement software updates, patches, and feature enhancements.

 Database and Systems Integration 
 Design, manage, and maintain relational and non-relational databases, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle including SQL optimization and ORM technologies.

 Develop database queries, stored procedures, and data integration solutions.

 Ensure data integrity, security, and backup procedures are followed.

 Cybersecurity and Compliance 
 Follow secure coding standards and cybersecurity best practices.

 Assist with vulnerability remediation and security testing.

 Maintain compliance with organizational policies and industry standards.

 Protect sensitive data and ensure secure authentication methods are implemented.

 
 
 Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field preferred.  4 additional years of experience can be applied in lieu of degree.

 Must have at least an active Secret Security clearance with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI clearance within 1 year.

 Minimum 4 or more years of experience in web and application development.

 Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and experience may be considered.

 Experience with mobile app development, cloud services, and enterprise applications preferred.

 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

 Knowledge of cybersecurity and secure coding practices

 Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes

 Active TS/SCI security clearance

 DABAOPP1
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
